servicesSummary: Republic of Vanuatu The office of Deputy comissioner,c/c Vanuatu Maritime Services LTD., is responsible for the promotions of the registration of vessels under the Vanuatu Flag. Part of our services is to contact individuals among the ship industry by letter, fax and phone, email or visits to inform them of Vanuatu Ship Registry. We prepare official documents on behalf of the Vanuatu Goverment for ship owners and financial institutions.
moneyExplanation: The supplemental statement reports $925,669.00 in total disbursements for this registrant during the filing period. These are registrant-level filing totals and are not automatically attributable to any one foreign principal.
extractionMethod: Text of the original DOJ FARA supplemental filing; source-verified structured extraction
coverage: Registrant-level filing totals are reported only when the form provides an explicit total. Itemized financial rows require an exact known principal, real date, counterparty, purpose and amount. U.S. political contacts require an itemized principal/date/contact/method/purpose row. No payment to a politician or principal-specific share is inferred.
